appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
A single blue line connects one point per year from 1880 (left) to 1891 (right).
The line begins at the lowest visible value on the chart, near the 1,000 gridline.
The line ends at the highest visible value on the chart, near the 3,000 gridline.
The line shows a local dip around 1886, sitting below the 1885 and 1887 points but above the 1880–1883 points.
The highest point on the line is at 1890, near 3,300; the 1891 point is slightly lower but still the second-highest.

printed_facts.fact: 'Year' with ticks 1880 through 1891 in one-year steps.

public_definitions: Task scope: 'Review the Town Z new-tourists dashboard for 1880-1891, then choose the tourism program route that matches the overall visitor trend.'
Option 1: 'Route Town Z to tourism growth planning'.
Option 2: 'Route Town Z to tourism decline response'.
Option 3: 'Keep Town Z on routine tourism monitoring'.
uncertain: The chart title states 'Decreasing' while the plotted line rises from ~1,000 in 1880 to ~3,000 in 1891; the title and the visual data conflict, so the basis for the 'overall trend' (title text vs. plotted line) is unresolved.
No numeric data labels are printed on the line, so exact per-year values are read only from gridline proximity.
